label: DAY 10
title: I made a dice game for 6 bots. The one that never busts lost 73% of its games.

scenes.title: The safe bot
scenes.caption: rolls once, always banks
lines: This bot never busts. It rolls once and banks. Out of fifty thousand games, it lost seventy three percent.

scenes.title: My dice game

items.text: Roll as often as you want
Each roll adds to your pot

lines: I coded a dice game. Roll as many times as you like, and every roll adds to your pot.
Roll a number you already rolled this turn, and you lose the pot. Bank whenever you want. First to fifty wins.

scenes.title: Six bots

items.text: Math: rolls if it pays on average

lines: Six bots. Three bank after one, two, or three rolls. One rolls until its pot hits twelve.
One does the math every roll. And one never banks at all. Every pair played ten thousand games.

scenes.title: The bot that never banks
scenes.caption: never banks
lines: The never bot built a pot of sixteen here, then rolled a repeat and lost it. It won twenty three games out of fifty thousand.

scenes.title: Points per turn
lines: Over a hundred thousand turns each, the bot that rolls three times busts almost half the time, and still scores as much as the one that rolls twice.
Never busting meant just three and a half points a turn.

scenes.title: Games won
lines: In wins, the math bot came first with seventy six percent. The safe bot won just twenty seven. Only the never bot did worse.

scenes.title: The math bot
scenes.caption: rolls only if it pays
lines: Here it rolls five, one, four. Pot of ten. Then it stops.

scenes.title: Its one rule
lines: Its rule: add up the numbers you haven't rolled. That's the upside.
Compare it to how many numbers you've rolled, times the pot. If the risk is bigger, bank.

scenes.text: Never risking anything came second to last.
scenes.sub: what rule should I give the next bot?
lines: Never risking anything came second to last. What rule should the next bot try? Tell me in the comments.
